title: Pacific Presents #4 Pacific Comics 1984 Shell Game Bruce Jones Helmut Eppich
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Pacific Presents #4 (June 1984), Pacific Comics - "Shell Game" by Bruce Jones and Helmut Eppich, with Ian Akin and Brian Garvey. Noir detective cover. Original $1.50 cover price ($2.00 in Canada).

Back cover: Groo Special #1 ad by Sergio Aragones.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
